# v2.4.7 source payload fixtures

These three files were generated by executing the real upstream Ledger v2.4.7
Go types at commit `6fc0fe23682e1f0915729d8c3a6814fd7ef34752`, using
`generate-v2.4.7.go.txt`. The generator does not import the v3 adapter types.

Upstream `internal/storage/ledger/logs.go:64` serializes `log.Data` with
`json.Marshal` and stores those bytes in `logs.data` at line 84. The generator
executes exactly that serialization operation on actual upstream
`CreatedTransaction` and `RevertedTransaction` values. The latter has nested
`revertedTransaction` and `transaction` objects (`internal/log.go:370–373`).
Only the separate `GetMemento` representation flattens `revertedTransactionID`
(`internal/log.go:388–411`); these fixtures are not mementos.
`internal/transaction.go:190–204` supplies the upstream custom transaction
encoder, including the computed `reverted` property. The compensating
transaction uses upstream `MarkReverts`, as the actual controller does at
`internal/controller/ledger/controller_default.go:546`.

Transaction 0 independently credits `unrelated` with 25 USD. Transaction 1
credits `alice` with 100 USD. Transaction 2 reverses transaction 1, debiting
`alice` by 100 USD. Creation timestamps are 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z and the revert
is at 01:00:00Z. These files contain only `logs.data`; tests supply ordered
source log IDs 1, 2, 3 independently of transaction IDs 0, 1, 2.

## Reproduction

From the repository root with the upstream commit available locally:

```sh
mkdir -p build/en-2025/upstream
git archive 6fc0fe23682e1f0915729d8c3a6814fd7ef34752 | tar -x -C build/en-2025/upstream
mkdir -p build/en-2025/upstream/cmd/en2025fixture
cp internal/adapter/v2/testdata/generate-v2.4.7.go.txt build/en-2025/upstream/cmd/en2025fixture/main.go
nix develop --command bash scripts/agent-validation-env build/en-2025/fixture-validation bash -c 'fixture_dir="$PWD/internal/adapter/v2/testdata"; cd build/en-2025/upstream && go run ./cmd/en2025fixture "$fixture_dir"'
```

Expected SHA256 values:

```text
517a3e810d11bcff57bb5a9704708279d4403c85269d5e8f98c8fc53b3d883bf  v2.4.7-new-transaction-0.json
20b4671703681caa8d5cefbbb7cebc55acb3dc0faab3c40da05f64f43c123cee  v2.4.7-new-transaction-1.json
b7d12eca5f1caefa93017b714ccd86fb9cd62659058c37c418b9d1812cf63dd0  v2.4.7-reverted-transaction-1.json
```

## Evidence limits

The upstream encoder was executed successfully under the repository-pinned Nix
Go toolchain with `scripts/agent-validation-env` and its normal shared caches.
No PostgreSQL server, upstream API server, transaction controller, or live
source ingestion was executed. These are deterministic source-type fixtures
of the bytes passed to `logs.data`, not captured database rows. They establish
the payload contract and isolate decoding/application from HTTP pagination;
they do not establish database-driver, SQL selection, or full live-source
compatibility. Transaction volume projections are omitted to keep the fixture
focused on source identity and postings.
